explained.summary: Two short rules: if it isn’t right, don’t do it, and if it isn’t true, don’t say it. The text breaks off after this, probably damaged in the surviving manuscript, but the core is complete. Much of ethical life can be steered by these two tests applied in the moment.
explained.today: Before forwarding the juicy rumour, ask whether it’s true. Before quietly fudging the expenses or a timesheet, ask whether it’s right. If the answer is no, that settles it, however small the matter feels.
